verdict.rationale: Raygun's own docs show it handles native mobile crash artifacts: it accepts dSYMs, which implies iOS symbolication, and ProGuard mapping files, which implies Android deobfuscation. It also captures device, OS, and version context for each error. However, the pack contains no iOS or Android SDK crash-capture documentation and nothing on NDK, so mobile capture is inferred rather than documented. Missing for 10: explicit iOS and Android SDK crash-capture docs, any NDK/native C++ crash support, explicit app-version context for mobile crashes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture native mobile crashes — iOS, Android, NDK — with the device, OS, and app-version context needed to reproduce them
